card.name: Anesthetic concentration and titration wording
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or spaces right before a number or goal in anesthesia dosing text, such as "concentrations of", "needed to", "required for" and "until". It appears mostly in desflurane and propofol passages.

modes.label: Before a concentration value
modes.description: A space after "concentrations of" or "exceeding", just before a percent or MAC figure.
modes.example: Concentrations of Desflurane exceeding<< >>1 MAC may increase heart rate.

modes.label: Linking word before anesthesia effect
modes.description: A verb or preposition such as "produce", "for" or "until" leading into induction or maintenance of anesthesia.
modes.example: decrease the amount of desflurane (MAC) needed to<< produce>> anesthesia.

card.plain: It fires on the small words and spaces just before an anesthetic concentration or an induction endpoint is stated.
